what_this_is: Figures this site attributes to a source, written as strings that should appear in that source's own page text. A checker fetches each source and looks for them. This catches a source being edited, a number drifting, or a citation that never supported its claim in the first place.
what_this_is_not: This is a spot-check that a figure APPEARS in a source, not that we have represented the source fairly. A number can be present on a page and still be quoted out of context. Only a human reading the source can confirm that, and the site says so.
coverage_limit: cdc.gov and fda.gov refuse automated requests - CDC with 403, FDA with 404 on every URL including its homepage - so neither can be checked here. That is why the outbreak counts on this site are cited to the news reporting that carried them rather than to agency pages nobody has read. The claims below cover the comparison anchors, the pathogen-behaviour guidance and the reporting itself, all of which are reachable and checkable.
